meaning: Public source foundation with stable enough provenance for future field-level gates.
allowed_use: Future source-safe planning and possible review/model lanes after field receipts.
blocked_use: Automatic approval of every field or production use.
minimum_evidence: Public access, provenance, row grain, IDs or safe joins, coverage, licensing, and use gate.
notes: Green foundation is still not a blanket source promotion.

meaning: Source or subset may be considered for review-only use after required receipts.
allowed_use: Review-only planning and future source-admission hardening.
minimum_evidence: Receipt chain, identity audit, missingness/coverage audit, licensing check, leakage check.
notes: Often applies to safe subsets of broader partial sources.

meaning: Source can inform review context but is not model-approved.
allowed_use: Human review, planning, source map, caveat-aware analysis.
blocked_use: Model inputs, source truth, production rankings, hidden sorts.
minimum_evidence: Known source, caveats, use gate, and reason it stays review-only.

meaning: Source can be displayed or cited as context only.
allowed_use: Display/human context if allowed by use gate.
blocked_use: Formula input, model feature, source truth, ranking logic.
minimum_evidence: Display provenance and caveats; no model-use path.
notes: Display-only never becomes formula input by appearing in a backlog.

meaning: Source has incomplete seasons, positions, teams, rows, fields, or thresholds.
allowed_use: Future planning or limited review with explicit coverage caveat.
blocked_use: Broad historical validation or production use as complete source.
minimum_evidence: Coverage matrix, missingness audit, and eligibility thresholds.

meaning: Public or visible data exists but provenance, update policy, or reproducibility is incomplete.
allowed_use: Source-discovery lead or cautious review context.
blocked_use: Model/source-truth use and unqualified historical claims.
minimum_evidence: Stable access proof, receipts, hashes, licensing, and update policy.

meaning: Source is commercial, licensed, subscription, proprietary, or otherwise not available for NWR source-safe use.
allowed_use: Blocked unless licensed and admitted separately.
blocked_use: Any model, source-truth, scoring, or production use.
minimum_evidence: Explicit license/use rights, export contract, receipts, identity, and Master HQ approval.
notes: Includes PFF, SIS, Sportradar, commercial FTN unless separately admitted.

meaning: No safe public reproducible source was identified.
allowed_use: Blocked; may appear only as source-discovery question.
blocked_use: Use as approved input or metric denominator.
minimum_evidence: Stable public or licensed source with receipts and governance packet.
notes: Open web snippets do not satisfy this.

meaning: Identity keys or joins are unsafe, ambiguous, name-only, or collision-prone.
blocked_use: Approved joins, model inputs, source truth, scoring.
minimum_evidence: Durable IDs or audited crosswalk with collision/unmatched handling.
notes: Name-only joins remain blocked as approved joins.

meaning: Source or field uses current/future information for historical features or cannot prove as-of safety.
allowed_use: Blocked for historical validation and model use.
blocked_use: Backtests, replays, model features, formula candidates.
minimum_evidence: Decision-date receipts, point-in-time data, and leakage audit.

meaning: Route/YPRR/TPRR denominator is absent, partial, display-only, or not admitted.
blocked_use: True route metrics, route share, first downs per route, source-truth denominator.
minimum_evidence: Safe full routes-run denominator source with all eligibility and receipt requirements.
notes: Participation labels, snaps, and team attempts are not routes.

meaning: Source, field, method, or artifact is prohibited for NWR use.
blocked_use: Any analytical, display, model, source-truth, or production use.
minimum_evidence: Separate Master HQ decision would be required to reconsider.
notes: Use for scraped proprietary data, forbidden fields, or unsafe outputs.

meaning: Evidence is insufficient to classify safely.
allowed_use: Preserve as unresolved blocker and research question.
blocked_use: Guessing, promotion, model use, source truth, scoring, or claims of readiness.
minimum_evidence: Missing evidence list and what would unblock classification.
notes: This is the preferred label when receipts are incomplete.
